How we collected user feedback

We tested Tutor MX with users through a Google Forms survey from 26 September to 2 October 2026, with nine recorded submissions. The charts, written comments, our analysis and the improvement we made in response are recorded in full below.

The Sprint 2, Sprint 3 and final submission rubric pages link here for their user-feedback criteria.

Survey results and improvements

The live evidence page below provides the nine-response chart gallery, professional analysis for Questions 1–10, feedback triage and the downloadable source-response PDF. The feedback was collected before the final 11 October source audit; it does not prove usability of that final commit.
